description:
Super Mario Bros. (NES). Each completed level (reaching the flag/castle)
is a check. Optionally, collecting coins and 1-Ups also grants checks.
Abilities (mushroom/fire flower) are unlocked by receiving items from
the multiworld; if "Ability Gating" is enabled, picking up the power-up
in a level without having unlocked the matching item shrinks you back
down instantly.

v1.0.0.description:
That’s right after a long time, a new version of this Archipelago has arrived.
This new version fixes a bunch of bugs, including:
- Bugs in the checks for randomized levels.
- Issues with progressive items.
- Checks failing to apply.
Fixed Errors:
Level Randomizer (It remains in the experimental stage until it is confirmed to be free of errors.)
Progressive Items

Note: Please do not use save states. Why? They cause errors with checks and issues with the Death Link feature.
